theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Cleanest upward-trend leader by rank and absolute-trend eligibility, with a solid durability bar (0.68), healthy breadth (0.75) and no crowding flag. The gate_helps=true leg means respecting this eligible uptrend is consistent with the one validated drawdown-control edge, though rank itself carries no return-forecasting power.

theses.subject: AI Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Strongest durability leg in the eligible set (0.85) with trend-tagged Hurst and very high breadth (0.917), uncrowded (0.69). This is the most cohesive, persistent trend in the detector — supported by the trend-gate discipline rather than any momentum-return claim.
theses.dissent: It shares the SMH proxy with the leader and other semiconductor names; if the whole AI-hardware complex rolls over together, the high durability score would not protect a diversified basket drawdown.

falsifier.text: SMH closes below its 50-day moving average and stays there for 10 consecutive trading days

theses.subject: Cybersecurity

theses.dissent: Crowding here is the highest in the eligible top tier; the guardrail explicitly warns attention/inflow spikes mark tops, so chasing this crowded trend has the least favourable risk texture of the leaders.

falsifier.text: CIBR breaks below its 20-day low and fails to recover it within 5 trading days
